pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.45.7: athakho sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.45.12: tena kho pana samayena rājagahe thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā antevāsī bhikkhunī thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā upaṭṭhākakulaṃ gantvā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.1: tena kho pana samayena vesāliyaṃ āyasmato ajjukassa upaṭṭhākassa gahapatino dve dārakā honti putto ca bhāgineyyo ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.2: athakho so gahapati āyasmantaṃ ajjukaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.3: imaṃ bhante okāsaṃ yo imesaṃ dvinnaṃ dārakānaṃ saddho hoti pasanno tassa ācikkheyyāsīti. so kālamakāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.4: tena kho pana samayena tassa gahapatino bhāgineyyo saddho hoti pasanno. athakho āyasmā ajjuko taṃ okāsaṃ tassa dārakassa ācikkhi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.5: so tena sāpateyyena kuṭumbañca saṇṭhapesi dānañca paṭṭhapesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.6: athakho tassa gahapatino putto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.7: ko nu kho bhante ānanda pituno dāyajjo putto vā bhāgineyyo vāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.9: ayaṃ bhante ayyo ajjuko amhākaṃ sāpateyyaṃ amhākaṃ methunakassa ācikkhīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.11: athakho āyasmā ajjuko āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.13: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upāli āyasmato ajjukassa pakkho hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.14: athakho āyasmā upāli āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.15: yo nu kho āvuso ānanda sāmikena imaṃ okāsaṃ itthannāmassa ācikkhāhīti vutto tassa ācikkhati kiṃ so āpajjatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.16: na so bhante kiñci āpajjati antamaso dukkaṭamattampīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.46.17: ayaṃ āvuso āyasmā ajjuko sāmikena imaṃ okāsaṃ itthannāmassa ācikkhāhīti vutto tassa ācikkhi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.47.1: tena kho pana samayena bārāṇasiyaṃ āyasmato pilindavacchassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ corehi upaddutaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.47.3: athakho āyasmā pilindavaccho te dārake iddhiyā ānetvā pāsāde ṭhapesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.47.8: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā pilindavaccho corehi nīte dārake ānessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.48.1: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhū sahāyakā honti paṇḍako ca kapilo ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.48.3: athakho tassa bhikkhuno gāmakā kosambiṃ gacchantassa antarāmagge nadiṃ tarantassa sūkarikānaṃ hatthato muttā medavaṭṭi pāde laggā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.48.7: taṃ uttiṇṇaṃ aññatarā gopālikā passitvā etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.48.9: so pakatiyāpāhaṃ assamaṇoti tassā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:7.49.1: tena kho pana samayena sāgalāyaṃ āyasmato daḷhikassa saddhivihāriko bhikkhu anabhiratiyā pīḷito āpaṇikassa veṭhanaṃ avaharitvā āyasmantaṃ daḷhikaṃ etadavoca
